description: Is Motif still seeing this website? Last tracker event, last identified visitor, backend signup feed health, and the breakage alerts Motif's hourly check has open (tracker silent, signups silent or unmatched, visits dropped, Stripe or Search Console disconnected). An alert opens only once that check has recorded it, so judge the tracker by live and last_event_at too; empty alerts alone does not prove nothing is broken.

website_id.description: website id (uuid) or the site domain (example.com); omit when the account has one website
